expected_response.note: No registered bounded edit is supported by the supplied evidence; incumbent retained with no temperature change.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A on the basis of pair-kernel shell contrasts would treat a diagnostic feature as a force the executing scalar does not contain, and could displace surrounding coordinates without an affinity-first justification.

A region_index or temporal_region_index edit would change teacher coordinates or regional attention while the temporal curves are non-monotone with many sign conflicts and only 24 curves pass the fidelity rule, risking mis-specified attention at actual score nodes.

A teacher_neighbors edit confuses neighbor count with distance bandwidth; low top-4 teacher overlap (0.470) and weak chosen teacher score correlation (0.102) mean a narrower or broader neighborhood is not supported.
A temporal_teacher_blend edit would mix a static last-learning-node forecast with observed teachers without decoded terminal labels, so any predicted benefit would be unverifiable.
Relying on survival or increment credit as if it were decoded terminal affinity would overstate a recorded joint-head credit that does not survive multiplicity adjustment.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible endpoint contrasts are on pair-distance shell densities (pair_kernel_1.5-3.5 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 reversed) and on shape anisotropy (shape_yy/shape_xx negative), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). No registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) maps onto those observables, so no operative reward edit can be connected to the Analyst's leading hypotheses without treating a diagnostic feature as a force the formula does not contain. The curvature parameter pointcloud_delta_A is the only distance-response knob, and the evidence supplies no signed contrast on the pointcloud scalar itself; the pair-kernel shell pattern is not a distance-bandwidth result and cannot justify narrowing or broadening delta. Region and temporal-region edits would change teacher coordinates or regional attention, but the temporal evidence is contrast curves with 3-10 sign changes, rejected polynomial fits and only 24 of the tested curves passing the fidelity rule, and the static teacher is a last-learning-node forecast rather than a final structure; the joint diagnostics show the reproducible signal is coherent internal deformation, which the pointcloud scalar does not encode. Teacher-neighbor count is a count, not a bandwidth, and the audit reports top-4 teacher overlap 0.470 with chosen teacher score correlation 0.102, so changing k is not supported. Survival and increment credit are recorded joint-head credit with no decoded terminal labels and no surviving multiplicity adjustment, so they cannot justify displacing the incumbent. Affinity-first priority plus the absence of a defensible expected advantage favors retaining the incumbent rather than an unsupported edit.
